title.narrative: Resilient, gender-responsive (separated where possible) WASH services were provided in 8 healthcare facilities in the Upper West and Upper West Regions, reaching about 50,000 clients (about 12,000 children) and about 100 staff. Procurement is in progress for the commencement of similar interventions in 45 healthcare facilities, as well as the designs for WASH improvements in 50 second cycle schools.  Consultations have been initaited within the Education and Health sectors to strengthen systems for the sustainable and reliable delivery of WASH services in institutions. Two schools (training centre and Junior High school) benefitted from WASH infrastructure improved during emergency response  2,356 stiudents.
